// <auto-generated/>
#nullable enable
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using System.Net.WebSockets;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Threading.Channels;

namespace __RUNTIME_NAMESPACE__.Ws;

public sealed record WsMessage(string Channel, string Data, string? Uid);

public sealed record WsResult<T>(string Channel, T? Value, string RawText,
    bool? ServerSuccess = null, JsonElement? Errors = null)
{
    public bool Success => ServerSuccess != false;
}

public class WsEndPointClient : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim connectLock = new(1, 1);
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim sendLock = new(1, 1);
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, TaskCompletionSource<WsMessage>> pending = new();
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<long, Channel<WsMessage>> subscribers = new();
    private ClientWebSocket? socket;
    private long subscriberId;
    private bool disposed;

    public string Path { get; }
    public string BaseUrl { get; }
    public bool AutoReconnect { get; set; } = true;
    public TimeSpan ReconnectDelay { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
    public TimeSpan RequestTimeout { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
    public Action<ClientWebSocketOptions>? ConfigureWebSocket { get; set; }

    public WsEndPointClient(string path, string? baseUrl = null)
    {
        Path = path;
        BaseUrl = baseUrl?.TrimEnd('/') ?? "";
    }

    public async Task ConnectAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(disposed, this);
        if (socket?.State == WebSocketState.Open) return;
        await connectLock.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
        try
        {
            if (socket?.State == WebSocketState.Open) return;
            socket?.Dispose();
            var next = new ClientWebSocket();
            try
            {
                ConfigureWebSocket?.Invoke(next.Options);
                await next.ConnectAsync(new Uri(BaseUrl + Path), cancellationToken);
            }
            catch { next.Dispose(); throw; }
            socket = next;
            _ = ReceiveAsync(next);
        }
        finally { connectLock.Release(); }
    }

    public async Task SendAsync(string channel, object? data = null, string? uid = null,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await ConnectAsync(cancellationToken);
        var body = WsJson.Serialize(data ?? new { });
        var message = WsJson.Serialize(new { channel, data = body, uid });
        var bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(message);
        await sendLock.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
        try { await socket!.SendAsync(bytes, WebSocketMessageType.Text, true, cancellationToken); }
        finally { sendLock.Release(); }
    }

    public async Task<WsResult<T>> RequestAsync<T>(string channel, object? data = null,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var uid = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
        var completion = new TaskCompletionSource<WsMessage>(TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
        pending[uid] = completion;
        using var timeout = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
        timeout.CancelAfter(RequestTimeout);
        try
        {
            await SendAsync(channel, data, uid, timeout.Token);
            var reply = await completion.Task.WaitAsync(timeout.Token);
            T? value = default;
            bool? success = null;
            JsonElement? errors = null;
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(reply.Data))
            {
                using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(reply.Data);
                var root = document.RootElement;
                if (root.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object && root.TryGetProperty("Success", out var serverSuccess))
                {
                    success = serverSuccess.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.True;
                    if (root.TryGetProperty("Errors", out var serverErrors)) errors = serverErrors.Clone();
                    if (root.TryGetProperty("Result", out var result)) value = WsJson.Deserialize<T>(result.GetRawText());
                }
                else value = WsJson.Deserialize<T>(reply.Data);
            }
            return new WsResult<T>(reply.Channel, value, reply.Data, success, errors);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested && timeout.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            throw new TimeoutException($"La requête WebSocket '{channel}' a dépassé le délai de {RequestTimeout}.");
        }
        finally { pending.TryRemove(uid, out _); }
    }

    public async IAsyncEnumerable<WsMessage> ListenAsync(
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        while (true)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            var id = Interlocked.Increment(ref subscriberId);
            var channel = Channel.CreateUnbounded<WsMessage>();
            subscribers[id] = channel;
            try
            {
                var connected = false;
                try { await ConnectAsync(cancellationToken); connected = true; }
                catch (Exception error) when (AutoReconnect && IsTransient(error, cancellationToken)) { }
                if (connected)
                {
                    await using var reader = channel.Reader.ReadAllAsync(cancellationToken)
                        .GetAsyncEnumerator(cancellationToken);
                    while (true)
                    {
                        bool hasMessage;
                        try { hasMessage = await reader.MoveNextAsync(); }
                        catch (Exception error) when (AutoReconnect && IsTransient(error, cancellationToken))
                        { break; }
                        if (!hasMessage) break;
                        yield return reader.Current;
                    }
                }
            }
            finally { subscribers.TryRemove(id, out _); }
            if (!AutoReconnect) yield break;
            await Task.Delay(ReconnectDelay, cancellationToken);
        }
    }

    private static bool IsTransient(Exception error, CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
        !cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested &&
        error is WebSocketException or HttpRequestException or IOException or OperationCanceledException;

    private async Task ReceiveAsync(ClientWebSocket current)
    {
        Exception? failure = null;
        var buffer = new byte[4096];
        try
        {
            while (current.State == WebSocketState.Open)
            {
                using var message = new MemoryStream();
                ValueWebSocketReceiveResult result;
                do
                {
                    result = await current.ReceiveAsync(buffer.AsMemory(), CancellationToken.None);
                    if (result.MessageType == WebSocketMessageType.Close) return;
                    message.Write(buffer, 0, result.Count);
                } while (!result.EndOfMessage);
                if (result.MessageType != WebSocketMessageType.Text) continue;
                using var json = JsonDocument.Parse(message.ToArray());
                var root = json.RootElement;
                var channelName = root.GetProperty("channel").GetString() ?? "";
                var data = root.TryGetProperty("data", out var content) ? content.GetString() ?? "" : "";
                var uid = root.TryGetProperty("uid", out var key) ? key.GetString() : null;
                var received = new WsMessage(channelName, data, uid);
                if (uid != null && pending.TryRemove(uid, out var completion)) completion.TrySetResult(received);
                foreach (var subscriber in subscribers.Values) subscriber.Writer.TryWrite(received);
            }
        }
        catch (Exception error) { failure = error; }
        finally
        {
            var active = ReferenceEquals(socket, current);
            if (active) socket = null;
            current.Dispose();
            if (active)
            {
                failure ??= new WebSocketException("La connexion WebSocket est fermée.");
                foreach (var request in pending.Values) request.TrySetException(failure);
                pending.Clear();
                foreach (var subscriber in subscribers.Values) subscriber.Writer.TryComplete(failure);
                subscribers.Clear();
            }
        }
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        if (disposed) return;
        disposed = true;
        var current = socket;
        socket = null;
        if (current is { State: WebSocketState.Open })
        {
            try { await current.CloseAsync(WebSocketCloseStatus.NormalClosure, null, CancellationToken.None); }
            catch (WebSocketException) { }
            catch (ObjectDisposedException) { }
        }
        current?.Dispose();
        foreach (var request in pending.Values)
            request.TrySetException(new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(WsEndPointClient)));
        pending.Clear();
        foreach (var subscriber in subscribers.Values) subscriber.Writer.TryComplete();
        subscribers.Clear();
        connectLock.Dispose();
        sendLock.Dispose();
    }
}

public abstract class WsRouterClient(string? baseUrl = null, bool autoReconnect = true,
    TimeSpan? reconnectDelay = null, TimeSpan? requestTimeout = null,
    Action<ClientWebSocketOptions>? configureWebSocket = null) : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, WsEndPointClient> endpoints = new();
    protected WsEndPointClient GetEndPoint(string path) =>
        endpoints.GetOrAdd(path, route => new WsEndPointClient(route, baseUrl)
        {
            AutoReconnect = autoReconnect,
            ReconnectDelay = reconnectDelay ?? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1),
            RequestTimeout = requestTimeout ?? TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30),
            ConfigureWebSocket = configureWebSocket
        });

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        foreach (var endpoint in endpoints.Values) await endpoint.DisposeAsync();
        endpoints.Clear();
    }
}

public abstract class WsEventClient<T>(WsEndPointClient endpoint, Func<string> topicFactory)
{
    protected WsEventClient(WsEndPointClient endpoint, string topic) : this(endpoint, () => topic) { }
    public WsEndPointClient EndPoint { get; } = endpoint;
    public string Topic => topicFactory();

    public async IAsyncEnumerable<T?> ListenAsync(
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await foreach (var message in EndPoint.ListenAsync(cancellationToken))
            if (string.Equals(message.Channel, Topic, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                yield return WsJson.Deserialize<T>(message.Data);
    }
}

internal static class WsJson
{
    private static readonly Type? JsonConvert = Type.GetType("Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert, Newtonsoft.Json");
    private static readonly MethodInfo? SerializeMethod = JsonConvert?.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)
        .FirstOrDefault(method => method.Name == "SerializeObject" && !method.IsGenericMethod &&
            method.GetParameters().Length == 1);
    private static readonly MethodInfo? DeserializeMethod = JsonConvert?.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)
        .FirstOrDefault(method => method.Name == "DeserializeObject" && method.IsGenericMethodDefinition &&
            method.GetParameters().Length == 1 && method.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType == typeof(string));
    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Options = new() { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };

    public static string Serialize(object? value) => SerializeMethod?.Invoke(null, [value]) as string ??
        JsonSerializer.Serialize(value, Options);
    public static T? Deserialize<T>(string json) => DeserializeMethod == null
        ? JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(json, Options)
        : (T?)DeserializeMethod.MakeGenericMethod(typeof(T)).Invoke(null, [json]);
}
